annotations.title: Q3 2026 loan markdowns as BDCs file

description: Live through earnings season: BDC funds that cut a first-lien loan's mark by 5+ points from Jun 30 to Sep 30 2026, pulled from each Q3 10-Q on EDGAR the day it is filed, biggest cut first, with the holders that have not filed Q3 yet and still carry the same loan 5+ points higher (likely next markdowns). Free: the top 10. full=true: every cut with every pending holder with a Tensorust key.

full.description: true returns every cut and pending holder. Needs a Tensorust key (Authorization: Bearer tdk_...).
